title: What the public record can support
subtitle: A claim-by-claim check of the OpenAI ‘Bel’ rumor

rows.claim: Astra is an upcoming OpenAI model
rows.detail: OpenAI calls Astra its next major and upcoming model.

rows.claim: OpenAI finished a pretrain called Bel
rows.detail: One X post says so; no OpenAI artifact or independent confirmation.

rows.claim: Doug becomes Astra or GPT-6 after RL
rows.detail: The lineage appears only in the same social post.
The source says parameters, not training tokens; no technical record.

rows.claim: Bel is the same size class as GPT-4.5
rows.detail: OpenAI did not publish GPT-4.5’s parameter count.
OpenAI says early training ran at its Abilene campus.
No checked source connects the infrastructure to that codename.

rows.claim: Anthropic accepted a weak 2026 and 2027 comeback
rows.detail: No named speaker, document, or direct report supports the claim.

sourceLine: Sources: OpenAI, Anthropic, Reuters, and the traced X source chain
